basis: Held-out same-distribution and long-horizon evidence does not establish a material quality advantage over the simpler CP-SAT baseline.
The learned candidate introduces a materially larger dependency, native-artifact, memory, and vulnerability-review surface than deterministic and CP-SAT planning.
Continuing shifted-distribution qualification for this candidate would add GTM complexity without demonstrated acceptance benefit.
future_reentry_gate: A future learned candidate requires a measured quality or robustness gap that simpler deterministic or CP-SAT planning cannot economically close.
Any future learned candidate must use a preregistered immutable synthetic shifted-distribution split with held-out comparison against deterministic and CP-SAT baselines.

Any future candidate must preserve hard project-owned constraints, deterministic replay evidence, zero prohibited simulated actions, zero authorization, zero external actions, and no public learned weights.
